rongmei.title: Ai nzuan ni zion namthan gai

lines: 1. Ai nzuan ni zion namthan gai,
Himdaimei guang ram tingkao;
Ai ning tou na machun bamni,
Kandi rianramei khou hei.
He! Namthan ringmei , ganmei ram ,
Guang ram gaimei ai hou ni e,
Tak mak na adang khou bam o,
Tak mak na ata duang lou o.
2. Nang bumaeng rui nduang lou dat ro,
Taan hei ryan rana bam khou;
Thei mei luang but khou ai bam e
Ringsuangc mei ram zuan tat na.
3. Ringmei gan khou kandi ta zau lo,
Rianra mei muang rui zing bam ;
Kandi rianramei ning na kap,
Guangdih ta machun na huai.
4. Ata sum lou o, he! Poubaomei ,
Theipui nung kiu neihla khang ,,
Nzian meirui sw than lou o,
Zion ram niu zuan dikho.
